[Intro]
[G]
[Em]
[C]
[Dadd11]
I

[Verse 1]
[G]have to block out thoughts of you so
I don’t lose my head They
[Em]crawl in like a cockroach, leaving
babies in my bed Dropping
[C]little reels of tape to re-
mind me that I’m alone Playing
[Am]movies in my head that make a por-
no feel like home There's a
[G]burning in my pride, a nervous blee-
ding in my brain An ounce of
[Em]peace is all I want for you; will you
never call again? And will you
[C]never say that you loved me just to
put it in my face? And will you
[Am]never try to reach me? It is I
that wanted space Hate me today

[Chorus]
[G]
Hate me tomor-
[Em]row
Hate me for all
[C]the things I
[D]didn't do for you
[Em]
Hate me in ways
[G]
Yeah, ways hard
[Em]to swallow
Hate me so
[C]you can finally
[D]see what’s good for you
[G]
I’m

[Verse 2]
[G]sober now for three whole months It’s one ac-
complishment that you helped me with The
[Em]one thing that always tore us apart is the
one thing I won’t touch again In a
[C]sick way, I want to thank you for holding my
head up late at night While I was
[Am]busy waging wars on myself, you were
trying to stop the fight You never
[G]doubted my warped opinions on things like
suicidal hate You made me
[Em]compliment myself when it was way
too hard to take So I’ll drive
[C]so fucking far away that I
never cross your mind And
[Am]do whatever it takes in your heart to
leave me behind Hate me today

[Chorus]
[G]
Hate me tomor-
[Em]row
Hate me for all

[D]didn't do for you
[Em]
Hate me in
[G]ways
Yeah, ways hard
[Em]to swallow
Hate me so you
[C]can finally
[D]see what’s good for you
[G]
And with a

[Break]
[C]sad heart, I say bye to you and wave
[D]Kicking sha-
[G]dows on the street for [D/F#]every mis-
[Em]take that I had made And like a
[Am]baby boy, I never was a man
[D]Until I
[G]saw your blue eyes cry and [D/F#]I held your
[Em]face in my hand And then I
[Am]fell down yelling, Make it go a-
[D]way! Just make a smile
[G]come back and shine [D/F#]just like it
[Em]used to be And then she
[Am]whispered How can you do this to me?
[D]
Hate me today

[Chorus]
[G]

[G]
For you
